title: The Winter Typewriter
author: Gideon Thackeray
blurb: Casper Thackeray, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the census taker asks one question too many, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
